Its really just based off of whether
- The WoD is universal in terms of anybody being able to run it, as well as provide Effects that are beneficial in any Lineup such as Arithmatecia or Hand Size
- L Examples: Thais, Tulu, Base Murphy, Castor, GMurphy 
- The WoD is versatile in its application, only being usable by a select few, but the users are so proficient that they are not held back by its limitation, granting Effects that could raise the Damage Output of the Wielder for instance 
- L Examples: Lily, Tawil, Clementine, Doresain, Kathigu-Ra

Each month the purchases available refresh.
